policy: V1 imports no third-party source code, course prose, exercises, tests, images, brand assets or state data. A permissive license does not remove the need for attribution/notice if copying ever occurs; the selected default is original reimplementation.

entries.license_or_terms: Official documentation; no project-wide reuse license asserted here
entries.prohibited_or_requires_review: Copying substantial prose, examples, assets or implied endorsement

entries.license_or_terms: Per-skill LICENSE.txt; repository page marked deprecated
entries.prohibited_or_requires_review: Any file-level reuse without checking the exact skill license and current guidance

entries.allowed_in_v1: Original implementation of abstract course-flow ideas
entries.prohibited_or_requires_review: Copying lesson prose, diagrams, samples, translations, logos or course sequence as content

entries.license_or_terms: BSD-3-Clause in main repository; associated CurriculumExpansion is CC-BY-SA-4.0
entries.prohibited_or_requires_review: Copying curriculum prose, challenge text, tests, media or any associated repository without per-file license check
Copying exercises, tests, canonical data, reference solutions or generated READMEs
Copying source, prompts, docs, UI text or tests without Apache notice compliance and separate review
Copying framework code, API signatures, documentation or tests

entries.planned_use: Negative scope and high-level content/state separation observation
entries.prohibited_or_requires_review: Copying, modifying, linking implementation pieces, demo course content or creating derivative integration
Course text, questions, media, derivative course structure for commercial/closed distribution

entries.license_or_terms: AGPL-3.0-or-later; docs-site has CC BY-SA 4.0; assets have separate notes
entries.planned_use: Recognize spaced review as a product need only
entries.prohibited_or_requires_review: Code, scheduling algorithm, UI, logo, documentation, translations or card content

entries.license_or_terms: Vendor documentation and software may have separate terms
entries.planned_use: Factual hardware capability and safety verification
entries.allowed_in_v1: Paraphrased facts with source URL; user-specific pinout requires exact datasheet/board confirmation
entries.prohibited_or_requires_review: Bundling Cube firmware, example code, data sheets, diagrams or mixed-license packages

entries.asset: Articles and institutional learning reports in source ledger
entries.license_or_terms: Mixed: government publication, publisher copyright and institutional terms
entries.allowed_in_v1: Short citations and paraphrased design rationale
entries.prohibited_or_requires_review: Long excerpts, figures, tables, copies of assignments or textbook-like redistribution
